name: Çiçekli Vazo
notes: Medium design, target 28–45 panes. Regenerated once to simplify the background, flower petals and vase bands. Final image has 36 closed colour components above 500 pixels (1086×1448); three tulips, three broad stems and five vase bands. Subject uses warm pair, background uses cool pair; exterior is opaque white. References: vitray_fox.png and vitray_lighthouse.png. Visual inspection: no obvious loose line ends; remaining concerns are subtle generated shading, some same-colour adjacency at stems and background, and crowded contacts where stems meet flowers/vase which require junction review during tracing. Design sheet only; geometry and game publication not performed.
